frame.note: Rocking modes are far above the shaper band; the weak link is the plate between the lower fan screw and the nearest support, so the compression pad at the 4th pattern corner matters (M10). The upper two PCB screws thread into an unknown part (UPPER_PATTERN_HOLES_TARGET, MISSING): if it is plastic, k_joint can fall well below the pessimistic case. Duct cantilever: owned by the Duct agent; keep its first mode > 150 Hz (2x X shaper) - a 30-40 mm thin-wall PC duct hung only at Z 22 needs its own rib.

probe_mount.option heatsink cross-hole (02:H14): printed path 13.8 mm -> 5.5 um/10 K, clamp lever ~18 mm, k >> 1000 N/mm; BLOCKED: its left cheek (X -17.9..-14.1, Y -3..10, Z 34..47) lies in LIDAR_RESERVED_BODY, and the hole's function is MISSING (may hold the carriage clamp)
probe_mount.option extruder bottom screws (02:E8): printed path ~36.8 mm -> 14.7 um/10 K; E8 holes (Y +10.1) sit 0.1 mm inside the heatsink rear face (Y +10.2), so a bracket must pass through the MISSING heatsink-to-carriage gap: not buildable without carriage data
probe_mount.verdict: Stiffness is not the limit for any option (sub-um deflection, kHz modes); the anchor joint (2 x ~M2 into unknown toolhead tabs) and thermal growth of the printed path are. The 785004 anchor is the default because it is proven in service at today's pin position; PA-CF + closed section cut thermal drift ~40 % vs a PLA/PETG 785004. The heatsink option halves the path but is blocked by the LiDAR body box until M6.
